claims.claim_text: ASPI/QLE has definitive agreements with TerraPower: a $22M (10% OID) term loan to partially fund construction of a uranium enrichment facility in Pelindaba, South Africa, plus an Initial Supply Agreement and a 10-year Long-Term Supply Agreement of up to 150 metric tons of HALEU (2028-2037).

claims.claim_text: ASPI is engaged with U.S. DOE, the NRC, and the UK ONR regarding construction of a nuclear fuel plant; in 2020 the DOE selected two companies under ARDP Pathway 1 (HALEU-fueled) and ~$2.7B has been awarded by DOE to jump-start commercial HALEU production (industry context). ASPI itself has not received any DOE HALEU contract or NRC enrichment license.

claims.claim_text: ASP Isotopes has a commercial Pre-Implementation Services Contract with Necsa (South African state nuclear company) for siting an enrichment facility at Pelindaba, South Africa; in addition QLE has a non-binding MoU with Necsa to collaborate on advanced nuclear fuel.
